changes.comment: Add quantity formatting for FieldRun values in text annotations. `FieldRun.formatOptions.quantity` (`kindOfQuantity`, `persistenceUnit`, `formatSet`) drives resolution: the effective (override, override-or-property) pair is tried first, then the property-side pair; if neither resolves, `"quantity"` and `"coordinate"` fall back to raw string. Formatting is available via `ElementDrivesTextAnnotation.evaluateFieldsAsync`; the synchronous `evaluateFields` and txn field-update callbacks format only when the host has registered a pre-warmed `FormattingSpecProvider` for the field's `formatSet`.
